ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_Color_Review_Gates) && ISCHANGED(CapStrat_Stage__c) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(CapStrat_Stage__c), "Response In Progress") && OR(ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Submitted - Awaiting Customer Decision"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "RFP Shortlisted"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Shortlisted - Awaiting Customer Decision"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Awarded")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Color_Review_Stage__c, "Complete")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Color_Review_Stage__c), "Complete"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All color reviews must be Complete before this bid can be marked Submitted, Shortlisted or Awarded. Cancelling or no-bidding is still allowed.
